mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.department, e.status, e.enrolled_at, e.cancelled_at, e.completed_at, e.completed_by, cu.real_name AS completed_by_name FROM enrollment e JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = e.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = e.completed_by WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} AND e.status = #{status} ORDER BY e.enrolled_at DESC, e.id DESC

SELECT e.id, e.status, e.enrolled_at, e.cancelled_at, e.completed_at, e.completed_by, c.id AS course_id, c.title, c.instructor, c.location, c.start_time, c.end_time FROM enrollment e JOIN course c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.status = #{status} ORDER BY c.start_time DESC, e.id DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM enrollment WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY status
